pr.title: Preserve collapse state in the SCM Repositories view
pr.body: Fixes #335411 The Source Control **Repositories** view re-expanded a repository that contains submodules every time the view became visible, so a collapsed parent repository could never stay collapsed: collapse it, switch to the Explorer, switch back, and it is expanded again. Two things caused this, both in `scmRepositoriesViewPane.ts`: 1. `renderBody` reads the persisted view state once and every later `setInput` reuses that same object. The persisted state is only written on `onWillSaveState`, so any expand/collapse the user did in between was thrown away whenever the view became visible again. 2. On every visibility change all already known repositories are re-registered through `onDidAddRepository`. For a repository with a `parentId` — a submodule — that path ends in `updateParentRepository`, which expanded the parent unconditionally. So the parent was force-expanded once per submodule, every time. ### Changes - Capture `tree.getViewState()` when the view becomes hidden and use it as the input view state on the next show, instead of the state loaded once at startup. - Thread an `expandParent` flag through `onDidAddRepository` / `updateRepository` / `updateParentRepository`. It is `true` for repositories that are genuinely added while the view is live and `false` for the re-registration loop. - Even when `expandParent` is `true`, only expand the parent if it was not collapsible before the update — i.e. only when it gains its *first* child repository. If it already had children, the user may have collapsed it on purpose. The initial "expand the parent when the first submodule shows up" behaviour is kept, and the "expand when there is only one repository" logic is untouched. ### Verification Built from source and tested manually on macOS: with `"scm.repositories.selectionMode": "single"` and the Repositories view visible, open a repository with submodules, collapse the parent, and switch between the Explorer and Source Control — the parent stays collapsed. Newly added submodules still expand the parent the first time. ### Before / After Collapse `demo-app` in the Repositories view, switch to the Explorer and back to Source Control. | Before (VS Code 1.143.1) | After (this PR) | |---|---| | | | The change is limited to a single file (`scmRepositoriesViewPane.ts`, +19/−8), and that file is unchanged on `main` since this branch was created, so the PR still applies cleanly.

commit.message:
Preserve collapse state in the SCM Repositories view

The Repositories view re-expanded a repository that has submodules every
time the view became visible, so a collapsed parent repository could not
be kept collapsed.

Two things caused this:

- The tree input was always set with the view state that was read from
  storage once in `renderBody`. That state is only written on
  `onWillSaveState`, so any expand/collapse done in the meantime was
  discarded when the view became visible again. Capture the current view
  state when the view is hidden and use it on the next show instead.
- When the view became visible, all known repositories were re-registered
  through `onDidAddRepository`, and for a repository with a `parentId`
  that unconditionally expanded the parent. Only expand the parent when it
  actually gains its first child repository.
